description: This file defines an interface for reading report mailing jobs within the Fineract project. It provides method signatures for retrieving all jobs, specific jobs by ID, enumeration options, and those marked as active.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for retrieving report mailing jobs and related data from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Fetches paged list of all report mailing jobs that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJob
methods.description: Fetches a single report mailing job by its unique ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobEnumOptions
methods.description: Provides enumeration or dropdown options for report mailing jobs.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Fetches all active report mailing jobs that are not marked as deleted.
